candidates.title: Compare supplier confirmations with purchase orders

demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: When a supplier confirmation contains dozens of line items, manually comparing every SKU, quantity, price, and delivery date against the original Purchase Order becomes time-consuming.

ease.reason: A beginner can compare operator supplied sample rows, but no attached source supports extraction or matching.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: ecommerce operators handling supplier orders might pay for less manual comparison; this post proves no buyer or payment.

feasibility.reason: A four-week mock can compare two supplied tables and flag field differences; varied documents and accuracy remain untested.

autonomy.reason: A proposed comparison can flag mismatches, while a person supplies records and verifies every difference before changing an order.

evidence.reason: The fresh post names manual comparison of SKU, quantity, price and delivery date, but gives no frequency or implementation evidence.

candidates.reason: Concrete chore assessed with a synthetic row-comparison experiment; mean 23/5 = 4.6, below 6. Also overlaps online-shop customer with recent post 98b4f6281cc3de4ecdfa95f6.
